does_not_prove: It writes to the test network only. The main network is not tested and costs real money.
The record has the proof form (version 0). The real record of the register (design 9.3) comes with Phase F.
The negative control shows that a submit key is enforced. It does not show that a stranger cannot find another way to post: that is the guarantee of the network itself.
The test network can be reset. The ids in this file may stop existing.
